items.title: Two tabs side by side
items.detail: Right-click a tab and choose Show Beside, or press ⌥⌘S, to see two sessions at once. Whatever you type, and commands such as ⌘W, go to the side you last clicked.

items.title: Drop a folder to type its path
items.detail: Type cd and a space, then drag a folder from Finder into a terminal: its path appears, ready for Return. Drag from a file browser's host pane to get the path on the server.

items.title: Tabs open while you drag
items.detail: Hold a drag over a tab for a moment and it opens, so you can drop onto any terminal.

items.title: Reconnect from the tab
items.detail: Right-click a tab whose session has ended and choose Reconnect.

items.title: What's New
items.detail: After an update, 7 Term shows what changed, like this. See it again any time with Help ▸ What's New.
